title: Care Management Clinical Policy: Complex Case Stratification and Transition-of-Care (TOC) Enrollment for Heart Failure
regulatory_framework: CMS Hospital Readmissions Reduction Program (HRRP) / NCQA Complex Case Management Standards (CM 1-4)
summary: Governs automated stratification and care plan authorization for high-risk Heart Failure patients transitioning from hospital to home. Triggers intensive RN care management, 48-hour post-discharge outreach, and cellular remote biometric monitoring.

criteria.name: Elevated 30-Day Readmission Risk (LACE Index >= 10 OR >= 2 Inpatient Admissions in 12 Months)
criteria.description: Patient exhibits documented high readmission vulnerability based on validated LACE score >= 10 or multi-admission history.
criteria.statutory_reference: NCQA CM 1: Identification and Assessment; CMS HRRP

criteria.name: Reduced Left Ventricular Ejection Fraction (LVEF <= 40%) or NYHA Class III/IV
criteria.description: Documented echocardiogram showing reduced LVEF <= 40% or advanced clinical symptomatic functional limitation.
criteria.statutory_reference: AHA/ACC/HFSA 2022 Guideline for the Management of Heart Failure

criteria.name: Identified Social Determinant of Health (SDOH) Vulnerability
criteria.description: Documentation of transportation barriers, food insecurity, cognitive impairment, or medication unaffordability.
criteria.statutory_reference: Healthy People 2030 / CMS Framework for Health Equity

criteria.name: Exclusion: Active Hospice or Palliative-Only Comfort Care Election
criteria.description: Exclude standard TOC pathway if patient has elected palliative/hospice comfort measures only; route to specialized palliative care protocol.
